description_text:
Lumbering but durable support vessels, arbiters are piloted by members of the Judicator Caste, and are infused with psionic energy. The Judicator uses the arbiter as a base to provide support using space-time manipulation. While capable of inflicting light damage. the arbiter is far more valued for its ability to create dynamic tactical advantages for the Great Fleet.
The Judicator can generate a large reality-warping field that serves to conceal nearby friendly units. The arbiter had to remain firmly anchored in space-time to generate the field and so is not concealed itself. Furthermore, arbiters can weaken space-time, tearing rifts in the fabric of space-time, creating a vortex linking another location to the arbiter's location. This can be used to move personnel and supplies over long distances. On the other hand, arbiters can also strengthen space-time and create discrete pockets of space-time, trapping objects and preventing those objects from interacting with objects outside of their pockets.

Banana Musaceae - RT Edition

===================================
All Wireshape 3D scanned models are exposed to postcapture process, resulting in assets with cleaned mesh, quad topology and real scale.
Accurate maps in high definition, with perfect seams and color depth to ensure high-end quality and the level of details.
Detailed capture and processing for faithfulness of shapes, textures and reliefs to the real surface.
3D scanner is all about faithfulness, ideal for productions that need to to keep the CGI with a high level of credibility.

description_text: Goku pendant 40mm tallThe character Goku is based on Sun Wukong (Son Goku in Japanese), the central character of the Chinese novel Journey to the West. To be creative with the idea of Sun Wukong, Toriyama designed Goku as a human boy with a monkey's tail, rather than a complete simian, because the tail would give the character a distinguishing feature. He later stated that the tail was a pain to draw, hence why he had it get cut off early on. Toriyama did not initially plan to make Goku an alien, it was not until the introduction of fighters from other planets that he established him as a Saiyan. Goku was given the ability to teleport to any planet in seconds, so that Toriyama could increase the pace of the story.

Kamisama is the wise and serene God of the Earth in the Dragon Ball universe. Of Namekian origin, he arrived on Earth as a young man and assumed the role of guardian of the planet after separating all the evil it contained, giving rise to his evil counterpart: Piccolo Daimaō. He resides in the Sacred Temple, a floating sanctuary above the clouds, where he watches over the balance of the world alongside Mr. Popo. FDM Printing (Filament)
Most common material: PLA (also suitable as a base for PETG and ABS with minimal adjustments).
General Parameters:
Layer Height: 0.16–0.20 mm (fine detail) / 0.28 mm (fast)
Nozzle Temperature: 200–210°C (PLA), 230–250°C (PETG), 240–260°C (ABS)
Bed Temperature: 50–60°C (PLA), 70–90°C (PETG/ABS)
Print Speed: 45–60 mm/s (fine detail), 80 mm/s (fast)
Retraction: 0.8–2 mm at 25–45 mm/s (depending on extruder)
Cooling: 100% for PLA, 30–50% for PETG, 0% for ABS
Bed Adhesion: Brim or skirt (3–5 lines); Use glue or lacquer if it peels off.
Infill: 15–25% for standard parts, 50–100% for structural parts.
Shells/Perimeters: 2–3 walls (minimum 1.2 mm).
Resin Printing (SLA / LCD / DLP)
Most common material: Standard gray or beige resin (for modeling and miniatures).
General Parameters:
Layer Height: 0.03–0.05 mm (high detail)
Base Exposure Time: 25–35 s (first 5–8 layers)
Normal Exposure Time: 1.8–3 s (depending on resin and screen power)
Retraction/Lift Speed: 60 mm/min (up), 120 mm/min (down)
Ambient Temperature: 22–28°C (ideal)
Supports: Model tilt between 30–45°, medium supports in delicate areas
Wash: 90–99% isopropyl alcohol (2 min with agitation or ultrasound)
UV Curing: 3–6 min total (depending on color and curing power)

description_text:
Calling all stargazers, galaxy-hoppers, and out-of-this-world fashionistas! This pendant set is perfect for necklaces, keychains, cosmic backpacks, or whatever vessel you travel the universe in. Designed to beam a bit of weird, wild charm into your orbit.
Every design includes two hook size options, crafted in Original Blend, and fully exported as STL files ready to print on your 3D printer of choice. No wormhole required. What's Included:
Exploding Head – When the universe blows your mind… daily.
Alien & Alien Monster – Because friendly or freaky, they still abduct hearts.
Robot – Sentient? Maybe. Adorable? Definitely.
Mage – The perfect space sorcerer. Because science and magic don’t have to be separate.
Dragon Face & Dragon – The galaxy’s most majestic space reptiles.
Satellite, Rocket & UFO – Get ready for lift-off, abductions optional.
Quarter Moons, Full Moon, Sun & Sun with Face – The whole cosmic family, now wearable.
Ringed Planet & Star – A little Saturn and starlight on your chest.
Sun Behind Clouds – Even in space, cloudy days happen.
Tornado & Comet – For the ones who bring chaos in style.
High Voltage – That’s not a spark, that’s just your vibe.
Icons sourced from OpenMoji.org Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0
Joke (but seriously):If anyone asks why you're wearing a UFO, just tell them it's for “signal boosting” — emotional and galactic.

description_text:
Stellan Gios was a human male Jedi Master who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. At one point, Vernestra Rwoh was his Jedi Padawan before she was promoted to Jedi Knight, and he was also stationed at the Jedi outpost on the planet Caragon-Viner. Stellan had risen through the ranks of the Order along with Avar Kriss and when they worked together they were seen as immense powerhouses on missions for the Order and the Galactic Republic.[1] Gios was formerly the Padawan of Master Rana Kant, and formed close bonds with Kriss and Elzar Mann during their time as apprentices, often serving as a voice of reason in the trio.[2]
Gios was considered optimistic and a natural teacher. He was well-respected and was also considered strong in the Force, and had light skin and brown hair.[1] Gios wielded a blue-bladed crossguard lightsaber with a collapsible physical crossguard.[2]

description_text:
Here comes the Pacifiers. Made for combat and trained in all environments, these soldiers are not something to take lightly. While the soldiers of Erah grow and train in the same planet, these soldiers are from a distant planet, where conditions are harsh. The name of the planet remains secret, and even it´s said that is not only one planet, but a small amount where outstanding individuals are selected for this role.
What you will see is a .ZIP file contaning 3 bodies with slightly different poses, which you can complement with a set of arms, pauldrons and heads. Some bodies come with empty pistol holder or knife holder, to give that little extra if you decide to put a pistol or knife in their hands. They are compatible with your favourite alternative models with the same size, as they are bigger than a normal human based miniature, needing a 32mm base.You will also notice that one of the bodies need a rock or something to stand on (you will see the rock as a STL file). They are done separatedly so is not necesarily stepping on a rock, but  anything else.
Please note that this model is for personal use only. If you are interested on selling my models, please contact me privately
Also, you will find a CHITUBOX .ZIP file containing the supported projects for each of the files. They have been done with automatic supports and I can´t guarantee a succesful print, so if you are experienced with supports please check the projects beforehand.
Happy printing!
RedBeardBits

description_text:
This texture pack offers 5 highly realistic PBR ground textures for gaming environments. Each texture has been meticulously crafted using photorealistic techniques to ensure an authentic and immersive experience for players.
The pack includes a variety of ground textures, such as dirt, grass, gravel, and sand, each with its own unique characteristics and features. The textures are designed to seamlessly tile, ensuring a smooth and continuous surface for players to walk on.
Despite their high level of detail, these textures have been optimized for a smaller file size, making them ideal for use in games and other real-time applications. They can be easily integrated into any game engine that supports PBR rendering, and their realistic appearance adds depth and dimension to game environments.
Whether you're creating a realistic outdoor scene, a post-apocalyptic wasteland, or anything in between, this texture pack provides an excellent foundation for your gaming environment. With its high level of detail, seamless tiling, and optimized file size, it's the perfect solution for game developers who want to create immersive and engaging gaming experiences.

description_text:
Dirtfoot is a legendary New Jersey dirt monster. He is an obvious parody of the legendary creature, Bigfoot. He is presumed to be homosexual as the only known photograph of him was at a gay pride parade. In the episode Dirtfoot he shares an underground apartment with Master Shake under a well which mysteriously appears in front of the Aqua Teens house as part of Shake's plan to attract women and money by getting purposely stuck in the well and reaping the media attention. The two are uneasy roommates, with Shake complaining about how he leaves his one giant sock laying on the couch, with his complaints usually resulting in a massive kick from Dirtfoot.
When Shake's original plan for attention fails, he resorts to pretending to get his hand stuck in a mailbox, which actually gets stuck; Dirtfoot comes to his rescue, finally attracting the media, who describe the rescue as Dirtfoot taking his lover in his arms, to Shake's insecure horror. At this time the Aqua Teen's neighbor, Carl, is being interviewed by local news outlets and tells them that they have been gay lovers (and a common law couple) for some time. Shake promptly cuts off his own head with a katana in order to prove how straight he is, while Dirtfoot is stabbed by an elderly woman (voiced by Dave Willis' real life Granny), who apparently accidentally hit him with her swords. 
Dr. Wongburger (Mr. Wongburger in Dickesode) is a recurring villain, serving as the primary antagonist in all his appearances. A creature of inconstant type, Wongburger first appears as an anthropomorphic who hails from Planet. In his second appearance, he has transformed himself into a creature in the shape of a human molar tooth, and in his third appearance he, through years of therapy, became a giant cheeseburger. He is consistently portrayed with blue and yellow shorts (these don't appear on his hamburger form) and spectacles, which (apart from the shape of his mouth) is the only constant visual motif of the character.

description_text:
Geri Dönüşüm Dünya Savaşçısı Heykeli modelinin kısa 3D modeli. Teması geri dönüşüm ve çevre koruma üzerine kurulu bir savaşçı figürünün heykelinin 3D temsilini tasvir eder. Bu, gezegenin eylemini ve savunmasını öneren dinamik bir pozda tasvir edilmiş güçlü ve sembolik bir figür olabilir. Savaşçı, sıkıştırılmış kutulara veya plastiğe benzeyen zırh plakaları, yeniden amaçlandırılmış metalden yapılmış bir silah veya geri dönüştürülmüş kumaşlardan dokunmuş giysiler gibi geri dönüştürülmüş malzemelerden yapılmış veya bunları temsil eden unsurlarla süslenebilir. Heykel ayrıca yapraklar, sarmaşıklar veya akan su gibi Dünya ve doğa sembollerini de içerebilir. Genel estetik, güç, kararlılık ve çevresel sürdürülebilirliğe bağlılık duygusu vermelidir. Stil, inanılır bir savaşçı figürünü tasvir eden gerçekçiden, karakterin sembolik doğasını vurgulayan daha stilize veya fantastik yorumlara kadar değişebilir. Heykel için hayal edilen malzemeler arasında metal (geri dönüştürülmüş malzemeleri düşündüren), taş (Dünya'yı temsil eden) veya geri dönüştürülmüş ve doğal unsurları vurgulamak için farklı doku ve renklerin birleşimi bile olabilir. Bu model, çevre bilinci kampanyaları, geri dönüşüm ve sürdürülebilirlik hakkındaki eğitim materyalleri, kamu sanatı enstalasyonları (dijital temsiller) ve çevresel veya süper kahraman temalı oyunlar veya animasyonlar için uygundur. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ ve BLEND formatlarında mevcuttur.

نموذج ثلاثي الأبعاد موجز لتمثال محارب إعادة تدوير الأرض. يصور نموذجًا ثلاثي الأبعاد لتمثال أو منحوتة لشخصية محارب يتمحور موضوعها حول إعادة التدوير وحماية البيئة. يمكن أن تكون هذه شخصية قوية ورمزية، ربما مصورة في وضعية ديناميكية توحي بالعمل والدفاع عن الكوكب. يمكن تزيين المحارب بعناصر مصنوعة من مواد معاد تدويرها أو تمثلها، مثل صفائح دروع تشبه العلب أو البلاستيك المضغوط، أو سلاح مصنوع من معدن معاد تدويره، أو ملابس منسوجة من أقمشة معاد تدويرها. يمكن أن يشتمل التمثال أيضًا على رموز للأرض والطبيعة، مثل الأوراق أو الكروم أو المياه المتدفقة. يجب أن ينقل الجمال العام إحساسًا بالقوة والتصميم والالتزام بالاستدامة البيئية. يمكن أن يتراوح الأسلوب من واقعي، يصور شخصية محارب موثوقة، إلى تفسيرات أكثر أناقة أو خيالية تؤكد على الطبيعة الرمزية للشخصية. يمكن أن تشمل المواد المتخيلة للتمثال المعدن (الذي يوحي بالمواد المعاد تدويرها) أو الحجر (الذي يمثل الأرض) أو حتى مزيجًا من القوام والألوان المختلفة لإبراز العناصر المعاد تدويرها والطبيعية. مناسب لحملات التوعية البيئية والمواد التعليمية حول إعادة التدوير والاستدامة والمنشآت الفنية العامة (تمثيلات رقمية) والألعاب أو الرسوم المتحركة ذات الطابع البيئي أو الخارق. متوفر بتنسيقات FBX و OBJ و STL و GLB و USDZ و BLEND.

回收地球战士雕像的简洁 3D 模型。描绘了一座以回收和环境保护为主题的战士人物雕像或雕塑的 3D 模型。这可能是一个强大而富有象征意义的人物，也许以一种动态的姿势描绘，暗示着行动和保卫地球。战士可以用由回收材料制成或代表回收材料的元素来装饰，例如类似于压缩罐或塑料的盔甲板、由再利用金属制成的武器或由回收织物编织而成的衣服。雕像还可以融入地球和自然的象征，例如树叶、藤蔓或流水。整体美学应传达力量、决心和对环境可持续性的承诺。风格可以从描绘可信的战士形象的写实风格，到更风格化或奇幻的诠释不等，后者强调角色的象征意义。雕像想象中的材料可能包括金属（暗示回收材料）、石头（代表地球），甚至不同纹理和颜色的组合，以突出回收和自然元素。适用于环保意识宣传活动、关于回收和可持续性的教育材料、公共艺术装置（数字表示）以及具有环保或超级英雄主题的游戏或动画。提供 FBX、OBJ、STL、GLB、USDZ 和 BLEND 格式。

재활용 지구 전사 조각상의 간결한 3D 모델입니다. 재활용 및 환경 보호를 주제로 하는 전사 형상의 조각상 3D 표현을 묘사합니다. 행성 방어와 행동을 암시하는 역동적인 자세로 묘사된 강력하고 상징적인 인물일 수 있습니다. 전사는 압축된 캔이나 플라스틱과 유사한 갑옷 판, 재활용된 금속으로 만든 무기, 재활용된 직물로 짠 옷과 같이 재활용된 재료로 만들어지거나 이를 나타내는 요소로 장식될 수 있습니다. 조각상에는 잎, 덩굴 또는 흐르는 물과 같은 지구와 자연의 상징도 포함될 수 있습니다. 전반적인 미학은 힘, 결단력 및 환경 지속 가능성에 대한 약속을 전달해야 합니다. 스타일은 믿을 수 있는 전사 형상을 묘사하는 사실적인 스타일부터 캐릭터의 상징적인 성격을 강조하는 더 양식화되거나 환상적인 해석까지 다양할 수 있습니다. 조각상에 상상된 재료에는 금속(재활용된 재료를 암시하는), 돌(지구를 나타내는) 또는 재활용된 요소와 자연 요소를 강조하기 위해 다양한 질감과 색상의 조합이 포함될 수 있습니다. 환경 인식 캠페인, 재활용 및 지속 가능성에 대한 교육 자료, 공공 미술 설치물(디지털 표현) 및 환경 또는 슈퍼히어로 테마가 있는 게임 또는 애니메이션에 적합합니다. description_text:
This is probably my best fidget toy! I printed dozens of them because people keep wanting them.
It's a small, but satisfying fidget toy. You'll probably not want to wear it all the day due to it's size, but it's unobtrusive enough so you can still do a lot of things while wearing it. But while wearing it, you have a fidget thing right at hand for some quick fidgeting. (I'm wearing one as I type this; and fidgeting with it when thinking about what to type next.)
Also the planet gears look like plus signs - for some positive influence :) and they look quite a bit mesmerizing when moving in perfect unison.
I uploaded 4 sizes, 14mm, 16mm, 18mm and 20mm. If you need another size, ask in the comments and there's a good chance I'll make that.
You might need to use a bit of force to break the gear loose at first, but after a bit of breaking in it is supposed to run quite smoothly.
Some tips if it doesn't turn:
Some filaments seem to handle this better than others; silk for example seems to be prone to fuse. I used basic and matte.Also you can try reducing the flow ratio by a few percent.Adjusting the XY size compensation is a third option to try (e.g. 0.02 for hole, -0.02 for contour).Happy fidgeting!

Nasa Fabric - As Seen From Space!
Bring the whole world to your desk with this large hexagon of 3D printed NASA Fabric, colored in vibrant green and blue to resemble our planet from space. Printed in one piece with a flexible, chainmail-style design, it bends, folds, and twists for endless fidgeting fun.

Please note: this design is very face-heavy, so it may take a few minutes to load and slice on slower computers—don’t worry, that’s normal!

description_text:
This is my high-quality Cartoon Rocket which I call the V3. This was created in Cinema 4D r20 so the file itself is in C4D format. This was designed with Quads and Tri's and fully made to a high quality. I have had added bevels into each quarter of the rocket, along with the bolts to giving this some great detail. The rocket is easy to modify or to be added to any scene. When purchasing this rocket you get the Rocket file which has also got the materials included within the file. I used Cinema 4d Physical renderer to create the preview pictures. However, the scene files are not included i.e. background, lights, camera, however it will not take much to create what it is you need to make this look great.
As for the Rights to this. I shall allow this to be used for anything apart from reselling, so if you need to make a great Youtube show then this is not a problem, however, it cannot be added to another site.
Why not give this Rocket a shot and I hope you like it, there are more designs to come in the near future :)
RegardsSubplay Studio's

description_text:
Sci-fi Desert Dino speeder / spaceship / flyer model. Made in 3dsMax2022 and textured in Substance Painter. Renders were created in SP Iray renderer. Model has 11592 polygons and 11238 vertices.
Model details:

  - Model pack contains .fbx / .max / .blend and .obj file formats. Textures aren’t embedded into each format and have to be plugged in manually. 

  - Fbx files are provided for 2014/2015, 2016/2017 and 2020 versions.

  - You might want to rescale the model to match scene size

  - Side pipes, engine connectors, turbine engine shafts and nozzles share same texture set (overlapping UVs)

  - Model is centered to the middle of its bottom part and placed to 0.0.0 scene coordinates

  - Textures come in a single 4k UV set

  - Texture pack contains .png textures optimized for Arnold, Vray, Corona, UnityHDmetal + .png/.jpeg and .targa files optimized for UE4

  - Nothing is animated

  - UV maps can be seen in screenshots section

  - Everything is named properly

  - Engines have their emissive map and a common metal map (when they are shut down)

Make sure to contact me if you want more details or some minor adaptations to the model.
As usual: best wishes and have a nice day!:D

description_text:
Baiterek (also Bayterek) is a monument and observation tower in Astana, Kazakhstan
The shape of Bayterek represents a poplar tree holding a golden egg. These come from a folktale of the tree of life, a central symbol in Turkic mythology, and Samruk the magical bird of happiness, said to have laid its egg between the branches of a poplar tree.
The 105m tall structure rises from a wide flat base within a raised plaza. It consists of a narrow cylindrical shaft, surrounded by white branch-like girders that flare out near the top, supporting a gold-mirrored 22m-diameter sphere. The base contains a ticket booth and exhibition space, with two lifts rising within the shaft to the observation deck within the 'egg'. Entrances to the monument are sunk below eye level, reached by stairs from the surrounding plaza.
The observation deck is 97m above ground level, corresponding to 1997, the year that Astana became the nation's capital. It consists of two levels, one with 360 degree views of Astana and beyond, with a second, higher level, reached by a flight of stairs. The top level features a gilded hand print of the right hand of Nursultan Nazarbayev, the first President of the independent Republic of Kazakhstan, mounted in an ornate pedestal. A plaque invites visitors to place a hand in the imprint and make a wish. Alongside the handprint, and also oriented in the direction of the presidential palace, is a wooden sculpture of a globe and 16 radiating segments, commemorating the Congress of Leaders of World and Traditional Religions, held several times in Astana.
A tourist attraction popular with foreign visitors and native Kazakhs alike, it is emblematic of the city, which became capital of the country in 1997
Height: Antenna spire: 105 m (344 ft) Top floor: 97 m (318 ft)

Layers of the Earth Internal structure blow up diagram is ideal for school project science fair. It is a great educational tool for science teachers and students. It is ready to be printed and comes with photoshop post processing files including all layers. This geography model is perfect for animations, games, advertisements and presentations. This Lowpoly cross sectional earth model is easy to print and reuse. The 3d files are clean, well grouped and ready to print. Model axis point is set in the middle so it can be rotated or animated easily. Each layer of the earth can be individually rotated.

  - The sphere was made using 12015 triangles for a smooth curved surface. 

  - A few materials and texture has been used. 

  - Model layers are precisely aligned to the central axis. 

Available in lower versions of sketchup and everything is grouped separately in Sketchup 3d file. Formats include LUMION LS11, SKP, OBJ, STL, PSD Photoshop post processing files, 3D model export files and lumion file . Files included are High res JPG and sketchup files in higher and lower versions (2003, 2007, 2017, 2021). The files are free from any protection/encryption. The render settings are easy to follow and reuse. No special plugin needed to open the scene.

description_text:
This is the sigil of Lucifer made in 3D printing. Three files are being made available in STL format, the sigil, the base and the two in one part. Size: 60mm height.
Lucifer[a] is one of various figures in folklore associated with the planet Venus. The entity's name was subsequently absorbed into Christianity as a name for the devil. Modern scholarship generally translates the term in the relevant Bible passage (Isaiah 14:12), where the Greek Septuagint reads ὁ ἑωσφόρος ὁ πρωὶ, as morning star or shining one rather than as a proper noun, Lucifer, as found in the Latin Vulgate.
As a name for the Devil in Christian theology, the more common meaning in English, Lucifer is the rendering of the Hebrew word הֵילֵל, hêlēl, (pronunciation: hay-lale)[1] in Isaiah[2] given in the King James Version of the Bible. The translators of this version took the word from the Latin Vulgate,[3] which translated הֵילֵל by the Latin word lucifer (uncapitalized),[4][5] meaning the morning star, the planet Venus, or, as an adjective, light-bringing.[6]
As a name for the planet in its morning aspect, Lucifer (Light-Bringer) is a proper noun and is capitalized in English. In Greco-Roman civilization, it was often personified and considered a god[7] and in some versions considered a son of Aurora (the Dawn).[8] A similar name used by the Roman poet Catullus for the planet in its evening aspect is Noctifer (Night-Bringer). (Wikipedia).

description_text: Here is a photoscanned piece of brick wall debris that I scanned, cleaned, and optimized with great care to make it perfectly suitable for real-time rendering and games! Each texture set comes with the original 4096x4096 16-bit TIFF/ format and .PSD textures, as well 8-bit TARGA textures! All the texture maps adhere to the following naming convention: - *_Base (The Color/Base/Albedo Map) - *_NRM (The Normal Map - DirectX - Invert Green Channel for OpenGL) - *_Rough (The Roughness/Microsurface Map) - *_Metal (The Metallic/Metalness Map) - *_AO (The Ambient Occlusion Map) - *_ARM (A map containing the previously mentioned AO, Roughness, and Metallic maps into each of the images individual channels of a single image. Conserving texture memory in certain applications (UE4 for example.) The ARM suffix corresponds to RGB in that: Red Channel = Ambient Occlusion Green Channel = Roughness Map Blue Channel = Metallic Map Technical Note: If the model is displaying oddly in whatever rendering software you're viewing it in, make sure the software's Tangent Space is set to MikkT, if there is such an option. As this model was designed and created using MikkT tangent space. In almost all cases this shouldn't be an issue since MikkT is widely considered to be the standard tangent space encoding method. UE4, Substance Designer, and Substance Painter all use MikkT by default.

Special Price - 50% discount in all our models, dioramas and packs / Promotion valid from December 23 to 31, 2022
Biker Mice from Mars is an American television series created in 1993 by Rick Ungar and issued that year for three seasons. It tells the story of three humanized mice (Throttle, Modo, and Vinnie) who like to ride motorcycles. The Biker Mice escape from their home planet, Mars, due to an ecological disaster caused by the Plutarkians to crash land in the city of Chicago and there they meet Charlene Charley Davidson, a charmingly beautiful mechanic. They also discover that their enemies also came to Earth to plunder and exploit its natural resources.
This is part of a fanart created for those who enjoyed and grew up with this show. When I was a kid I enjoyed making this amazing characters in clay or something similar, but now with the same enthusiasm of my childhood and my new skills I can bring them back with a high level of quality for us.
We greatly appreciate when you download it that you give us a good rating to continue growing on the platform.
Disclaimer: By purchasing this product, you can print and collect the pieces. This does not include a commercial license, if you want to sell them, you must contact with us to expand reproduction rights. Although this collectibles are inspired by an existing series, the characters that here we are giving you are a complete reinterpretation of the ones you see in action figures or tvseries. We are not in the business of doing exact replicas.
If you have any question you can contact in our social media as instagram, facebook or whatsapp business
Thanks for believe in our project.

description_text:
I made this for a friend who loves watermelons, and I hope it can be shared with other like minded fans. A small container in the form of a segment of water melon. Broken down into 4 colour prints, to be constructed with a glue. I have changed the design to include a wall cavity in the lid to reduce material and increase volume of space inside.
DESCRIPTION
I have printed these on a solid fill in and with 30 degree supports on an UP!Plus 2, which took the following times and used the stated amount of each filament:
BLACK 1.6 g Print time = 15 minutes
WHITE 11.3g Print time = 1 Hr 57 minutes
RED 10.4g Print Time = 2 Hrs 1 minute
GREEN 18.5 g Print time = 2 Hrs 48 minutes
This does require some clean up and glue for assembly. I used a liquid solvent cement to join the red, white and black pieces together. A nice finishing trick was to use some acetone to melt and mix the red filament with the white into a sludge that could be painted on blending the join.

This device prevents lateral incidence of sun rays which affect your vision during driving. It is meant to increase comfort and safety. Please use wisely, never put it in a way that doesn't allow you to see the road or your side mirror. 
The model has been printed with Desktop 3D printers using PLA material, although using other filaments is also possible. The standard way to print it is with the front face upwards and using supports on the back side.
Upon request we can design a customized version of the model, including but not limited to: a different shape (i.e. the dog model) or a different design on the front face. The model has been designed to allow space for publicity on brands, logos, or free design. Please contact the owner with your idea or application and we can discuss further details. 
Safe driving!

BLENDER EEVEE SCENE!ANIMATEDCOMES WITH ALL FILES FOR EDITINGTO GET MORE BRIGHTNESS IN THE SUN, JUST PUT THE SUN MATERIAL BRIGHTNESS UP! HERE TO HELP YOU ANYTIME! 
The Solar System[a] is the gravitationally bound system of the Sun and the objects that orbit it, either directly or indirectly.[b] Of the objects that orbit the Sun directly, the largest are the eight planets,[c] with the remainder being smaller objects, such as the five dwarf planets and small Solar System bodies. Of the objects that orbit the Sun indirectly—the moons—two are larger than the smallest planet, Mercury.[d]
The Solar System formed 4.6 billion years ago from the gravitational collapse of a giant interstellar molecular cloud. The vast majority of the system's mass is in the Sun, with the majority of the remaining mass contained in Jupiter. The four smaller inner planets, Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars, are terrestrial planets, being primarily composed of rock and metal. The four outer planets are giant planets, being substantially more massive than the terrestrials. The two largest, Jupiter and Saturn, are gas giants, being composed mainly of hydrogen and helium; the two outermost planets, Uranus and Neptune, are ice giants, being composed mostly of substances with relatively high melting points compared with hydrogen and helium, called volatiles, such as water, ammonia and methane. All eight planets have almost circular orbits that lie within a nearly flat disc called the ecliptic.
The Solar System also contains smaller objects.[e] The asteroid belt, which lies between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, mostly contains objects composed, like the terrestrial planets, of rock and metal. Beyond Neptune's orbit lie the Kuiper belt and scattered disc, which are populations of trans-Neptunian objects composed mostly of ices, and beyond them a newly discovered population of sednoids. Within these populations are several dozen to possibly tens of thousands of objects large enough that they have been rounded by their own gravity.[10] Such objects are categorized as dwarf planets. Identified dwarf planets include the asteroid Ceres and the trans-Neptunian objects Pluto and Eris.[e] In addition to these two regions, various other small-body populations, including comets, centaurs and interplanetary dust clouds, freely travel between regions. Six of the planets, at least four of the dwarf planets, and many of the smaller bodies are orbited by natural satellites,[f] usually termed moons after the Moon. Each of the outer planets is encircled by planetary rings of dust and other small objects.
The solar wind, a stream of charged particles flowing outwards from the Sun, creates a bubble-like region in the interstellar medium known as the heliosphere. The heliopause is the point at which pressure from the solar wind is equal to the opposing pressure of the interstellar medium; it extends out to the edge of the scattered disc. The Oort cloud, which is thought to be the source for long-period comets, may also exist at a distance roughly a thousand times further than the heliosphere. The Solar System is located in the Orion Arm, 26,000 light-years from the center of the Milky Way galaxy.

These cookie cutters were printed from recycled PET from Reflow https://reflowfilament.com/
These models are cookie cutters to be 3D printed. They come in two options:-One piece cookie cutters. Recommended if you don’t want to mess with it too much.-Two part cookie cutters – the cutting part and the stamping part is separate. Great if you’re making a dough that is very thick or very thin. A simple 3D model of planet Earth with all kinds of cool textures like diffuse, glossy, illumination and clouds. All textures are real images took by NASA's satallite. The file even has a separate cloud sphere for animating moving clouds on your earth model.

The model would include a high-resolution texture map, which would be used to create a realistic appearance for the surface of the planet. This texture map would include a variety of features, including continents, oceans, mountains, and other landforms.
The model would also include a realistic atmosphere, complete with clouds, weather patterns, and other atmospheric effects. The atmosphere would be modeled using a combination of procedural techniques and image-based textures to create a realistic appearance.
To ensure that the model is suitable for use in both space documentaries and games, it would be designed to be highly optimized for real-time rendering. This would include efficient use of geometry and textures, as well as advanced techniques such as LOD (Level of Detail) optimization to ensure that the model can be rendered at different levels of detail depending on the distance from the camera.

description_text:
This is a very detailed and accurate low-poly model of planet Earth.
The file contains 2 objects:The first object is the planetThe second object is the clouds
In the video we show the model as a whole and then it without the cloud cover
Both objects have the same number of polygons.
The model includes a super-realistic atmosphere and clouds that adapt to the environment, simulating the visualization of the earth from a spatial perspective, where we can see that visually they adapt according to lighting, simulating day and night.
The model also includes a lighting map that is visible only in low light circumstances, which assimilates the night lights turned on by humans seen from space.
The model was originally made in blender (.blend).The model is available in fbx, obj, mtl versions.
6K textures were used.
In the original model, in addition to PBR textures, procedural nodes were used as a complement.

description_text: Starship is a fully reusable launch system in development by American aerospace company SpaceX, which consists of a first stage named Super Heavy and a second stage named Starship. Both stages are made from stainless steel and designed to hold liquid oxygen and liquid methane. Before launch, a specialized tower stacks Starship's stages and launch pad to mount the vehicle. During liftoff, Super Heavy's 33 Raptor engines produce 72 MN (16,000,000 lbf) of thrust, twice that of a Saturn V rocket. The Starship spacecraft fires three Vacuum Raptors in space, move two pairs of flaps to control its descent, and fires three Raptors during landing. Starship can send more than 100 metric tons (220,000 lb) to low Earth orbit; higher Earth and other orbits are accessible after being refueled by tanker Starships. Starship variants can also land on the Moon and Mars.

In diameter, the main mirror of the pendant measures 40mm with a thickness of 1.5mm. Overall height of the pendant 41.5mm, width 37mm and 44mm depth. El nudo místico, sin fin, eterno, infinito símbolo del feng shui, uso y significado. Este artículo pretende dar respuesta a las siguientes preguntas o búsquedas: nudo místico, nudo sin fin, nudo de la abundancia, nudo infinito, nudo tibetano, feng shui símbolos, símbolo del nudo, nudo del ocho y significados semejantes. Es un nudo de ocho en bucle que, en la India representa la diosa de la riqueza, mientras que en el feng shui se emblematiza como una serpiente que se muerde la cola.
Es uno de los ocho símbolos propicios del budismo tibetano. El nudo místico es una de las herramientas más poderosas para ganar suerte, éxito en cualquier negocio, prosperidad y felicidad. El nudo es una multiplicación de ocho repetidos (es decir, muchos símbolos beneficiosos del infinito), multiplicados y entrelazados entre sí.Nudo místico, sin fin, eterno, feng shuiRepresenta la naturaleza espiritual de nuestra propia existencia en el planeta, el nacimiento y el renacimiento, también es un símbolo del infinito amor. En sánscrito: Shrivatsa; en tibetano Dpal be'u, དཔལ་བེའུ. Tal vez sea una evolución de los naga, el antiguo símbolo de las dos serpientes entrelazadas. Está atado para que no se vea ni un principio ni un final.
Su principal significado es un símbolo multiplicado de un proceso interminable y continuo. Para el Feng Shui, el nudo místico es la personificación de incrementar el flujo de la suerte en el amor, el trabajo, la salud, etc. Depende del sector en el que lo coloques o del talismán al que lo ates. Muy a menudo en los talismanes chinos, se puede ver en un hilo rojo, activando un talismán como las monedas de Feng Shui.
También se habla de la ruta del cruce espiritual, del fluir del tiempo y el movimiento dentro de lo que es eterno. Se dice que toda la existencia está limitada por el tiempo y el cambio. Por tanto no es descabellado que represente el samsara, la unión de la sabiduría y el método, la vinculación de los antepasados y la omnipresencia¿Dónde mantenerlo, cómo usarlo?Preferiblemente que sea de color rojo; debe ser puesto en la parte sur-oeste de la habitación para mejorar la felicidad en las relaciones; en esa misma dirección debe ser usado en las oficinas o negocios para mejorar las relaciones comerciales, la armonía y lealtad con socios, empleados y clientes.Simbolismo del nudo tibetanoEl amuleto te ayudará a formular tus deseos y atraer la buena suerte. Por supuesto, hay que recordar que cualquier acción también tiene una reacción. Todo el mundo decide qué hacer por sí mismo. El nudo tibetano personifica el karma, la justicia. Los eventos creados por usted y para usted rebotarán en otros y regresarán a usted. Además, el nudo es la encarnación de la reencarnación, la infinidad de la vida en el universo. Todo lo material e inmaterial, vivo y no vivo, está interconectado.
Amor, abundancia y protección; protege también contra rotura del corazón, enfermedad, sufrimiento, accidentes, desgracias, el peligro, la ira y el miedo. Brinda claridad mental. Tallado en joyas, como ágata, jade o cristal de cuarzo, se considera más efectivo.
The mystical, endless, eternal, infinity knot feng shui symbol, use and meaning. This article aims to answer the following questions or searches: mystic knot, endless knot, abundance knot, infinity knot, Tibetan knot, feng shui symbols, knot symbol, eight knot and similar meanings. It is a knot of eight in a loop that, in India, represents the goddess of wealth, while in feng shui it is emblematized as a snake that bites its own tail.
It is one of the eight auspicious symbols in Tibetan Buddhism. The mystic knot is one of the most powerful tools to gain luck, success in any business, prosperity and happiness. The knot is a multiplication of eight repeated (that is, many beneficial symbols of infinity), multiplied and intertwined with each other.mystic knot, endless, eternal, feng shuiIt represents the spiritual nature of our own existence on the planet, birth and rebirth, it is also a symbol of infinite love. In Sanskrit: Shrivatsa; in Tibetan Dpal be'u, དཔལ་བེའུ. Perhaps it is an evolution of the naga, the ancient symbol of the two intertwined serpents. It is tied so that neither a beginning nor an end can be seen.
Its main meaning is a multiplied symbol of an endless and continuous process. For Feng Shui, the mystic knot is the personification of increasing the flow of luck in love, work, health, etc. It depends on the sector you place it in or the talisman you tie it to. Very often in Chinese talismans, it can be seen on a red thread, activating such a talisman as Feng Shui coins.
There is also talk of the route of spiritual crossing, of the flow of time and movement within what is eternal. All existence is said to be limited by time and change. Therefore it is not unreasonable that it represents samsara, the union of wisdom and method, the linking of ancestors and omnipresenceWhere to keep it, how to use it?Preferably red; should be placed in the south-west part of the room to enhance happiness in relationships; In the same direction, it should be used in offices or businesses to improve business relationships, harmony and loyalty with partners, employees and customers.Tibetan knot symbolismThe amulet will help you make your wishes and attract good luck. Of course, you have to remember that any action also has a reaction. Everyone decides what to do for himself. The Tibetan knot personifies karma, justice. Events created by you and for you will bounce off others and come back to you. Also, the knot is the embodiment of reincarnation, the infinity of life in the universe. Everything material and immaterial, living and non-living, is interconnected.
Love, abundance and protection; It also protects against heart break, illness, suffering, accidents, misfortunes, danger, anger and fear. Provides mental clarity. Carved into jewelry, such as agate, jade, or quartz crystal, it is considered more effective.

description_text:
This the best detailed model of Earth and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.
Model fully completed and 100% functional.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

  - Biggest definition textures ever seen.

  - Extreme detailed Lighting setup.

  - Real Earth Color Patterns.

  - Atmosphere shaders.

  - 4k (Earth Texture) (Diffuse, Reflect, Glossiness, Bump) (5400x2700px.)

  - 4k (Cloud Texture) (1200x630px.)

  - NO seams and texture issues visible on surface (only on earth poles).

  - Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night shader.

  - High quality fast render.

  - Compatible with MAX 2021 and later.

  - V-Ray Renderer are suported. (You will loose the ocean reflections on material if you don't use Vray engine, but you can re-adjust it quickly for the other render engine)

  - Reflective Ocean.

  - The best results near the surface ever seen.

  - 100% Ready to render, just open and wait until textures are loaded and enjoy!

  - Map coordinates atlas included, this is really useful to know where are each map placed on the earth.

  - HD Maps (4k) and LowSizeMaps (2k) are both supported on same scene and can be combinated at any combination.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
The scene contains:
3 Spheres
++++Earth Layer (Surface Material)
This is the Earth main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map.Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.
(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)
++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)
This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position.In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds..Clouds are on 1200px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.
++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)
This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.
No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.
IMPORTANT!:
The files comes with 1 version of the same model on 1 file:
'Earth_Vray2021' This is the complete Vray scene setup with better quality materials and settings.

  - Because the high size of textures you have to wait a while until the program load all textures.When the textures are loaded in max scene, the render no takes longer tan 1 minute, (1920x1080).This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.

  - Low size maps version works on any computer with 4GB of ram or more, for HD maps you can combine with the low size maps to get best results without wasting memory.All HD Maps are supported at same time in good computers.

description_text:
This is a 3D file to demonstrate the workings of a special clock system. It is similar to the complicated swizz clock and watch mechanisms but made far much simmpler and easier to understand. It is also designed in a way to redce wastage of plastics by having little to no support materials. 
This is an easier way of telling time by splitting the normal clock face into four equal portions. It has planets that not only rotate but also revolve around showing the different hours of the day. 
Each planet has three alternating numerals that cumulatively add up to the 12 hours in a day or night.
It is easy to setup and assemble and also easy to run because it uses a simple clock movement like those on quartz wall clocks. It also makes use of geneve gear mechanisms, this is an amazing opportunity to get hands on experience with this ancient and unique gear movement mechanism.
No arduino or servos required. And it only needs one screw to join everything together. 
The model is separated into groups of components that can easily fit within about 150mm by 150mm Print bed. I recomend using two or more contrasting filament colors. The difference in colours help to read the numerals easily because the help to stand out. 
THERE IS A PDF FILE ITH INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO ASSEMBLE THE MODEL. But still the items are prety much self explanatory and fool proof for easy of workability.Some parts may need trimming inorder to fit as intended so gear up with your tools, exactos and scapels. I can promise you, it's an exciting build.

description_text:
This the best detailed model of Earth and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.
Model fully completed and 100% functional.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

  - Biggest definition textures ever seen.

  - Extreme detailed Lighting setup.

  - Real Earth Color Patterns.

  - Atmosphere shaders.

  - 4k (Earth Texture) (Diffuse, Reflect, Glossiness, Bump) (1422x800px.)

  - 4k (Cloud Texture) (690x266px.)

  - NO seams and texture issues visible on surface (only on earth poles).

  - Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night shader.

  - High quality fast render.

  - Compatible with MAX 2021 and later.

  - V-Ray Renderer are suported. (You will loose the ocean reflections on material if you don't use Vray engine, but you can re-adjust it quickly for the other render engine)

  - Reflective Ocean.

  - The best results near the surface ever seen.

  - 100% Ready to render, just open and wait until textures are loaded and enjoy!

  - Map coordinates atlas included, this is really useful to know where are each map placed on the earth.

  - HD Maps (4k) and LowSizeMaps (2k) are both supported on same scene and can be combinated at any combination.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
The scene contains:
3 Spheres
++++Earth Layer (Surface Material)
This is the Earth main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map.Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.
(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)
++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)
This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position.In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds..Clouds are on 1200px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.
++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)
This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.
No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.
IMPORTANT!:
The files comes with 1 version of the same model on 1 file:
'Earth_Vray2021' This is the complete Vray scene setup with better quality materials and settings.

  - Because the high size of textures you have to wait a while until the program load all textures.When the textures are loaded in max scene, the render no takes longer tan 1 minute, (1920x1080).This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.

  - Low size maps version works on any computer with 4GB of ram or more, for HD maps you can combine with the low size maps to get best results without wasting memory.All HD Maps are supported at same time in good computers.

A scanned 3D model of a camel figure can provide a highly detailed and accurate representation of one of the most iconic desert animals in the world. The model would likely showcase the various physical features that make camels unique, including their distinctive humps, long legs, and tough, leathery skin.
Starting with the camel's humps, the model would likely depict two large, rounded mounds that sit atop the animal's back. These humps, which are actually fatty tissue reserves, are one of the camel's most well-known physical traits. The model might showcase the humps' texture and shape, from the smooth, rounded curves at the top to the wrinkled folds of skin beneath.
Moving down to the camel's legs, the model would likely highlight their long, slender shape and the many joints and bones that allow them to move with ease over uneven terrain. The model might also include details like the animal's large, cushioned foot pads, which help the camel traverse sandy or rocky landscapes with ease.
The camel's body itself would likely be depicted with a high level of detail in the 3D model. The animal's thick, leathery skin, which helps protect it from the harsh desert environment, might be shown with a rough texture and small, bumpy nodules. The model might also depict the camel's large, expressive eyes and its long, curved neck.
In addition to the physical features, a scanned 3D model of a camel figure might also showcase some of the animal's behavioral characteristics. For example, the model might depict the way a camel uses its long, flexible lips to grasp and manipulate food or the way it uses its powerful jaws to crush tough plant matter. The model might also showcase the camel's ability to store large amounts of water in its body, allowing it to survive for long periods of time without access to drinking water.
Overall, a scanned 3D model of a camel figure would provide an incredibly detailed and lifelike representation of one of the most fascinating animals on the planet. From its distinctive humps to its long, slender legs and tough, leathery skin, the model would capture every aspect of the camel's unique physiology and behavior, making it an invaluable tool for educators, researchers, and anyone else interested in learning more about these amazing creatures.

description_text:
Description
Description This the best detailed model of Pangea Earth and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.
Model fully completed and 100% functional.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Biggest definition textures ever seen. Extreme detailed Lighting setup. Real Earth Color Patterns. Atmosphere shaders. 4k (Pangea Earth Texture) (Diffuse, Reflect, Glossiness, Bump) (4000x2000px.) 4k (Cloud Texture) (1200x630px.) NO seams and texture issues visible on surface (only on earth poles). Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night shader. High quality fast render. Compatible with MAX 2022 and later. V-Ray Renderer are suported. (You will loose the ocean reflections on material if you don't use Vray engine, but you can re-adjust it quickly for the other render engine) Reflective Ocean. The best results near the surface ever seen. 100% Ready to render, just open and wait until textures are loaded and enjoy! Map coordinates atlas included, this is really useful to know where are each map placed on the earth. HD Maps (4k) and LowSizeMaps (2k) are both supported on same scene and can be combinated at any combination. +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
The scene contains:
3 Spheres
++++Earth Layer (Surface Material)
This is the Earth main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map. Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.
(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)
++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)
This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position. In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds.. Clouds are on 2000px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.
++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)
This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.
No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.
IMPORTANT!:
The files comes with 1 version of the same model on 1 file:
'Earth_Vray2022' This is the complete Vray scene setup with better quality materials and settings.
Because the high size of textures you have to wait a while until the program load all textures. When the textures are loaded in max scene, the render no takes longer tan 1 minute, (4000x2000px.). This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.
Low size maps version works on any computer with 64GB of ram or more, for HD maps you can combine with the low size maps to get best results without wasting memory. All HD Maps are supported at same time in good computers.

description_text:
DescriptionDescription Description Description Description Hi there,
this is a realistic mercury surface which can be used for documentaries or movies. The stars in the background are also included.
There are one surface main part which are instanced a couple of time to reduce the RAM Usage. There are also scattered small stones everywhere with Geometry Nodes for a more realistic look. The amount of subdivision are responsible, how realistic/detailed the mesh looks and can be adjusted in the modifier.
The scene is made in 3ds Max 2022. The download contains everything you see in the pictures.
Textures are packed in the file so that you only have to download the file and have everything you need.
Scene is made for the V-Ray Render Engine.
NOTE: I recommend to have at least 32GB of RAM due to heavy/detailed geometry and textures and the use of Subdivisions. Polygons and Vertices are more in the final render than in the preview (what is stated) due to the Subdivisions. So be aware that it takes some time to calculate before it renders.
If you get a RAM Error i would try the following things (alone or together):
Make sure you have closed all other applications and programs who are running in the background. Update to the latest 3ds Max Version. Deactivate Persistent Data in the Render Settings. Reduce the Dicing Scale of the Adaptive Subdivisions. Use 3ds Maxs Simplify Option to reduce Texture Sizes etc. Reduce the Render Resolution. If nothing helped you could switch to CPU Rendering but be aware that a CPU renders normally much slower than the GPU.

description_text: DescriptionDescription Description This the best detailed model of Pangea Earth and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.Model fully completed and 100% functional.+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++Biggest definition textures ever seen. Extreme detailed Lighting setup. Real Earth Color Patterns. Atmosphere shaders. 4k (Pangea Earth Texture) (Diffuse, Reflect, Glossiness, Bump) (1200x600px.) 4k (Cloud Texture) (1200x630px.) NO seams and texture issues visible on surface (only on earth poles). Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night shader. High quality fast render. Compatible with MAX 2022 and later. V-Ray Renderer are suported. (You will loose the ocean reflections on material if you don't use Vray engine, but you can re-adjust it quickly for the other render engine) Reflective Ocean. The best results near the surface ever seen. 100% Ready to render, just open and wait until textures are loaded and enjoy! Map coordinates atlas included, this is really useful to know where are each map placed on the earth. HD Maps (4k) and LowSizeMaps (2k) are both supported on same scene and can be combinated at any combination. +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++The scene contains:3 Spheres++++Earth Layer (Surface Material)This is the Earth main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map. Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position. In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds.. Clouds are on 1200px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.IMPORTANT!:The files comes with 1 version of the same model on 1 file:'Earth_Vray2022' This is the complete Vray scene setup with better quality materials and settings.Because the high size of textures you have to wait a while until the program load all textures. When the textures are loaded in max scene, the render no takes longer tan 1 minute, (1200x600). This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.Low size maps version works on any computer with 4GB of ram or more, for HD maps you can combine with the low size maps to get best results without wasting memory. All HD Maps are supported at same time in good computers.

description_text:
DescriptionThis the best detailed model of Earth In Daymap Position and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.
Model fully completed and 100% functional.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Biggest definition textures ever seen.Extreme detailed Lighting setup.Real Earth Color Patterns.Atmosphere shaders.4k (Earth Texture) (Diffuse, Reflect, Glossiness, Bump) (2048x1024px.)4k (Cloud Texture) (2048x1024px.)NO seams and texture issues visible on surface (only on earth poles).Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night shader.High quality fast render.Compatible with MAX 2022 and later.V-Ray Renderer are suported. (You will loose the ocean reflections on material if you don't use Vray engine, but you can re-adjust it quickly for the other render engine)Reflective Ocean.The best results near the surface ever seen.100% Ready to render, just open and wait until textures are loaded and enjoy!Map coordinates atlas included, this is really useful to know where are each map placed on the earth.HD Maps (4k) and LowSizeMaps (2k) are both supported on same scene and can be combinated at any combination.+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
The scene contains:
3 Spheres
++++Earth Layer (Surface Material)
This is the Earth main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map. Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.
(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)
++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)
This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position. In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds.. Clouds are on 1200px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.
++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)
This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.
No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.
IMPORTANT!:
The files comes with 1 version of the same model on 1 file:
'Earth_Vray2022' This is the complete Vray scene setup with better quality materials and settings.
Because the high size of textures you have to wait a while until the program load all textures. When the textures are loaded in max scene, the render no takes longer tan 1 minute, (1920x1080). This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.
Low size maps version works on any computer with 4GB of ram or more, for HD maps you can combine with the low size maps to get best results without wasting memory. All HD Maps are supported at same time in good computers.

DescriptionThis the best detailed model of The Moon Rotates Around The Earth and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite. It orbits at an average distance of 384,400 km (238,900 mi), about 30 times the diameter of Earth. Tidal forces between Earth and the Moon have synchronized the Moon's orbital period (lunar month) with its rotation period (lunar day) at 29.5 Earth days, causing the same side of the Moon to always face Earth. The Moon's gravitational pull—and, to a lesser extent, the Sun's—are the main drivers of Earth's tides.
Model fully completed and 100% functional.

++++Moon++++Earth
The earth contains:
3 Spheres
++++Earth Layer (Surface Material)
This is the Earth main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map. Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.
(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)
++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)
This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position. In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds.. Clouds are on 1200px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.
++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)
The moon contains:
++++Moon Surface (Surface Material)
This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.
No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.
IMPORTANT!:

This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.

description_text:
DescriptionThis the best detailed model of Gliece 581 D and comes equipped with the highest HD map textures.
Model fully completed and 100% functional.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Biggest definition textures ever seen.Extreme detailed Lighting setup.Real Earth Color Patterns.Atmosphere shaders.4k (Gliece 581 D Texture) (Diffuse, Reflect, Glossiness, Bump) (900x461px.)4k (Cloud Texture) (1200x630px.)NO seams and texture issues visible on surface (only on earth poles).Dynamic Day/Sunset/Night shader.High quality fast render.Compatible with MAX 2022 and later.V-Ray Renderer are suported. (You will loose the ocean reflections on material if you don't use Vray engine, but you can re-adjust it quickly for the other render engine)Reflective Ocean.The best results near the surface ever seen.100% Ready to render, just open and wait until textures are loaded and enjoy!Map coordinates atlas included, this is really useful to know where are each map placed on the earth.HD Maps (4k) and LowSizeMaps (2k) are both supported on same scene and can be combinated at any combination.+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
The scene contains:
3 Spheres
++++Gliece 581 D Layer (Surface Material)
This is the Gliece 581 D main layer, contains all textures that creates the big map.Special shaders are on it to avoid see seams on the textures.
(All shaders on this models has been applied directly using the material default settings to avoid using external plugins.)
++++Cloud Layer ( Cloud Map.)
This is the atmospheric layer that contains the clouds effect, it can be moved independently to another to get the clouds in exacly position.In the Vray scene the V-ray displacement cloud map effect can be enabled to get volumetric effect on clouds..Clouds are on 1200px resoultion, can be tiled on zones to get better results.
++++Atmosphere Layer (Atmosphere Shaded Material)
This atmospheric layer does not use texture and is compatible with the most common render engines like mental ray, deflaut scanline, Vray, real time renderer.
No external plugins are needed, deflaut render, Vray and mentalray.
IMPORTANT!:
The files comes with 1 version of the same model on 1 file:
'Earth_Vray2022' This is the complete Vray scene setup with better quality materials and settings.
Because the high size of textures you have to wait a while until the program load all textures.When the textures are loaded in max scene, the render no takes longer tan 1 minute, (1920x1080).This model has been designed to be used as parts, near the surface you can disable backfacing maps to save memory.
Low size maps version works on any computer with 4GB of ram or more, for HD maps you can combine with the low size maps to get best results without wasting memory.All HD Maps are supported at same time in good computers.

DescriptionHorsehead Nebula is a 3d model of a dark nebula located 1375 light years from Earth in the constellation Orion.
The Horsehead Nebula (B33) is a bright, large dark nebula located 1375 light years from Earth in the constellation Orion. The nebula is located just to the south of Alnitak, the easternmost star of Orion's Belt, and is part of the much larger Orion molecular cloud complex. With an apparent magnitude of 6.8 and an apparent size of 8 x 6 arcminutes, the nebula is visible in binoculars and easily observed in small telescopes in good conditions. Its striking appearance has earned it the nickname the Chess Knight Nebula. The Horsehead Nebula (B33) is one of the most iconic deep sky objects in the night sky.For astronomy science, extraterrestrial space exploration, space science, space travels, astro exploration science, celestial objects exploring, outer space, astronomy researches, and space exploring promotional projects.

description_text:
Superman was born Kal-El, on the fictional planet Krypton. 
As a baby, his parents Jor-El and Lara sent him to Earth in a small spaceship shortly before Krypton was destroyed in a natural cataclysm. 
His ship landed in the American countryside near the fictional town of Smallville, Kansas. He was found and adopted by farmers Jonathan and Martha Kent, who named him Clark Kent. 
Clark began developing superhuman abilities, such as incredible strength and impervious skin. 
His adoptive parents advised him to use his powers to benefit humanity, and he decided to fight crime as a vigilante. 
To protect his personal life, he changes into a colorful costume and uses the alias Superman when fighting crime. 
Note: Just a friendly reminder, but these files are not colored. The cover image is just a concept for the final design.
The duck dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 80
Width- 53
Depth- 81
Sculpting software used: Blender
Render method used for the previews: Cycles
Filament: PLA
Slicer used to 3D print: Ultimaker Cura
Settings I've used to 3D print:
Standard quality - 0.2mm
Infill - 20%
Supports - You will need supports for the duck's bill aka beak.
Speed - 50% first 20 layers and 100% for the rest
Plate Adhesion - Skirt
Cooling - Enabled
Travel - Retraction Enabled

description_text:
Description
Star Vega redirects here. For the psychologist, see Star Vega (psychologist). For other uses, see Vega (disambiguation). Vega is the brightest star in the northern constellation of Lyra. It has the Bayer designation α Lyrae, which is Latinised to Alpha Lyrae and abbreviated Alpha Lyr or α Lyr. This star is relatively close at only 25 light-years (7.7 parsecs) from the Sun, and one of the most luminous stars in the Sun's neighborhood. It is the fifth-brightest star in the night sky, and the second-brightest star in the northern celestial hemisphere, after Arcturus. Vega has been extensively studied by astronomers, leading it to be termed arguably the next most important star in the sky after the Sun. Vega was the northern pole star around 12,000 BCE and will be so again around the year 13,727, when its declination will be +86° 14′. Vega was the first star other than the Sun to have its image and spectrum photographed. It was one of the first stars whose distance was estimated through parallax measurements. Vega has functioned as the baseline for calibrating the photometric brightness scale and was one of the stars used to define the zero point for the UBV photometric system. Vega is only about a tenth of the age of the Sun, but since it is 2.1 times as massive, its expected lifetime is also one tenth of that of the Sun; both stars are at present approaching the midpoint of their main sequence lifetimes. Compared with the Sun, Vega has a lower abundance of elements heavier than helium. Vega is also a variable star—that is, a star whose brightness fluctuates. It is rotating rapidly with a speed of 236 km/s at the equator. This causes the equator to bulge outward due to centrifugal effects, and, as a result, there is a variation of temperature across the star's photosphere that reaches a maximum at the poles. From Earth, Vega is observed from the direction of one of these poles. Based on observations of more infrared radiation than expected, Vega appears to have a circumstellar disk of dust. This dust is likely to be the result of collisions between objects in an orbiting debris disk, which is analogous to the Kuiper belt in the Solar System. Stars that display an infrared excess due to dust emission are termed Vega-like stars. Observations by the James Webb Space Telescope show that the disk is exceptionally smooth, with no evidence of shaping by massive planets, though there is some evidence that there may be one or more Neptune-mass planets closer to the star.
Texture Resolution: 1014 x 1024

description_text:
Description
Star Vega redirects here. For the psychologist, see Star Vega (psychologist). For other uses, see Vega (disambiguation). Vega is the brightest star in the northern constellation of Lyra. It has the Bayer designation α Lyrae, which is Latinised to Alpha Lyrae and abbreviated Alpha Lyr or α Lyr. This star is relatively close at only 25 light-years (7.7 parsecs) from the Sun, and one of the most luminous stars in the Sun's neighborhood. It is the fifth-brightest star in the night sky, and the second-brightest star in the northern celestial hemisphere, after Arcturus. Vega has been extensively studied by astronomers, leading it to be termed arguably the next most important star in the sky after the Sun. Vega was the northern pole star around 12,000 BCE and will be so again around the year 13,727, when its declination will be +86° 14′. Vega was the first star other than the Sun to have its image and spectrum photographed. It was one of the first stars whose distance was estimated through parallax measurements. Vega has functioned as the baseline for calibrating the photometric brightness scale and was one of the stars used to define the zero point for the UBV photometric system. Vega is only about a tenth of the age of the Sun, but since it is 2.1 times as massive, its expected lifetime is also one tenth of that of the Sun; both stars are at present approaching the midpoint of their main sequence lifetimes. Compared with the Sun, Vega has a lower abundance of elements heavier than helium. Vega is also a variable star—that is, a star whose brightness fluctuates. It is rotating rapidly with a speed of 236 km/s at the equator. This causes the equator to bulge outward due to centrifugal effects, and, as a result, there is a variation of temperature across the star's photosphere that reaches a maximum at the poles. From Earth, Vega is observed from the direction of one of these poles. Based on observations of more infrared radiation than expected, Vega appears to have a circumstellar disk of dust. This dust is likely to be the result of collisions between objects in an orbiting debris disk, which is analogous to the Kuiper belt in the Solar System. Stars that display an infrared excess due to dust emission are termed Vega-like stars. Observations by the James Webb Space Telescope show that the disk is exceptionally smooth, with no evidence of shaping by massive planets, though there is some evidence that there may be one or more Neptune-mass planets closer to the star.

description_text:
DescriptionCosmic Microwave Background. The cosmic microwave background (CMB, CMBR), or relic radiation, is microwave radiation that fills all space in the observable universe. With a standard optical telescope, the background space between stars and galaxies is almost completely dark. However, a sufficiently sensitive radio telescope detects a faint background glow that is almost uniform and is not associated with any star, galaxy, or other object. This glow is strongest in the microwave region of the electromagnetic spectrum. The accidental discovery of the CMB in 1965 by American radio astronomers Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson was the culmination of work initiated in the 1940s. The CMB is landmark evidence of the Big Bang theory for the origin of the universe. In the Big Bang cosmological models, during the earliest periods, the universe was filled with an opaque fog of dense, hot plasma of sub-atomic particles. As the universe expanded, this plasma cooled to the point where protons and electrons combined to form neutral atoms of mostly hydrogen. Unlike the plasma, these atoms could not scatter thermal radiation by Thomson scattering, and so the universe became transparent. Known as the recombination epoch, this decoupling event released photons to travel freely through space. However, the photons have grown less energetic due to the cosmological redshift associated with the expansion of the universe. The surface of last scattering refers to a shell at the right distance in space so photons are now received that were originally emitted at the time of decoupling. The CMB is not completely smooth and uniform, showing a faint anisotropy that can be mapped by sensitive detectors. Ground and space-based experiments such as COBE, WMAP and Planck have been used to measure these temperature inhomogeneities. The anisotropy structure is determined by various interactions of matter and photons up to the point of decoupling, which results in a characteristic lumpy pattern that varies with angular scale. The distribution of the anisotropy across the sky has frequency components that can be represented by a power spectrum displaying a sequence of peaks and valleys. The peak values of this spectrum hold important information about the physical properties of the early universe: the first peak determines the overall curvature of the universe, while the second and third peak detail the density of normal matter and so-called dark matter, respectively. Extracting fine details from the CMB data can be challenging, since the emission has undergone modification by foreground features such as galaxy clusters.

description_text:
DescriptionShapley Supercluster. This Shapley Supercluster is like a space with stars in black and white background. The Shapley Supercluster or Shapley Concentration (SCl 124) is the largest concentration of galaxies in our nearby universe that forms a gravitationally interacting unit, thereby pulling itself together instead of expanding with the universe. It appears as a striking overdensity in the distribution of galaxies in the constellation of Centaurus. It is 650 million light-years away (z=0.046). In 1930, Harlow Shapley and his colleagues at the Harvard College Observatory started a survey of galaxies in the southern sky, using photographic plates obtained at the 24-inch Bruce telescope at Bloemfontein, South Africa. By 1932, Shapley reported the discovery of 76,000 galaxies brighter than 18th apparent magnitude in a third of the southern sky, based on galaxy counts from his plates. Some of this data was later published as part of the Harvard galaxy counts, intended to map galactic obscuration and to find the space density of galaxies. In this catalog, Shapley could see most of the 'Coma-Virgo cloud' (now known to be a superposition of the Coma Supercluster and the Virgo Supercluster), but found a 'cloud' in the constellation of Centaurus to be the most striking concentration of galaxies. He found it particularly interesting because of its great linear dimension, the numerous population and distinctly elongated form. This can be identified with what we now know as the core of the Shapley Supercluster. Shapley estimated the distance to this cloud to be 14 times that to the Virgo Cluster, from the average diameters of the galaxies. This would place the Shapley Supercluster at a distance of 231 Mpc, based on the current estimate of the distance to Virgo. In recent times, the Shapley Supercluster was named by Somak Raychaudhury, from a survey of galaxies from UK Schmidt Telescope Sky survey plates, using the Automated Plate Measuring Facility (APM) at the University of Cambridge in England. In this paper, the supercluster was named after Harlow Shapley, in recognition of his pioneering survey of galaxies in which this concentration of galaxies was first seen. Around the same time, Roberto Scaramella and co-workers had also noticed the Shapley Supercluster in the Abell catalogue of clusters of galaxies: they had named it the Alpha concentration.

DescriptionEl Gordo Cluster. This El Gordo Cluster is like a comet. El Gordo (lit. The Fat One) (ACT-CL J0102-4915 or SPT-CL J0102-4915) is the largest distant galaxy cluster observed at its distance or beyond, as of 2011. As of 2014, it held the record for being the largest distant galaxy cluster to have been discovered with a mass of slightly less than three quadrillion solar masses although later its mass was reduced to about 2.1×1015 (2.1 quadrillion) solar masses with a 10% uncertainty. It was found by NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory, the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (funded by the National Science Foundation) and the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope. This galaxy cluster, officially named as, 'ACT-CL J0102-4915', has been given a 'nickname' by the researchers as 'El Gordo', which stands for the Fat One or the Big One in Spanish. It is located more than 7 billion light-years from Earth. Findings and results on 'El Gordo' were announced at the 219th meeting of American Astronomical Society in Austin, Texas.

description_text:
DescriptionEl Gordo Cluster. This El Gordo Cluster is like a latin N letter. El Gordo (lit. The Fat One) (ACT-CL J0102-4915 or SPT-CL J0102-4915) is the largest distant galaxy cluster observed at its distance or beyond, as of 2011. As of 2014, it held the record for being the largest distant galaxy cluster to have been discovered with a mass of slightly less than three quadrillion solar masses although later its mass was reduced to about 2.1×1015 (2.1 quadrillion) solar masses with a 10% uncertainty. It was found by NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory, the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (funded by the National Science Foundation) and the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope. This galaxy cluster, officially named as, 'ACT-CL J0102-4915', has been given a 'nickname' by the researchers as 'El Gordo', which stands for the Fat One or the Big One in Spanish. It is located more than 7 billion light-years from Earth. Findings and results on 'El Gordo' were announced at the 219th meeting of American Astronomical Society in Austin, Texas.
