Physically based rendering (PBR) is an approach in computer graphics that seeks to render graphics in a way that more accurately models the flow of light in the real world. Many PBR pipelines have the accurate simulation of photorealism as their goal. Feasible and quick approximations of the bidirectional reflectance distribution function and rendering equation are of mathematical importance in this field. Photogrammetry may be used to help discover and encode accurate optical properties of materials. Shaders may be used to implement PBR principles.
ProcessPBR is, as Joe Wilson puts it, more of a concept than a strict set of rules[3] – but the concept contains several distinctive points of note. One of these is that – unlike many previous models that sought to differentiate surfaces between non-reflective and reflective – PBR recognizes that, in the real world, as John Hable puts it, everything is shiny.[4] Even flat or matte surfaces in the real world such as concrete will reflect a small degree of light, and many metals and liquids will reflect a great deal of it. Another thing that PBR models attempt to do is to integrate photogrammetry - measurements from photographs of real-world materials - to study and replicate real physical ranges of values to accurately simulate albedo, gloss, reflectivity, and other physical properties. Finally, PBR puts a great deal of emphasis on microfacets, and will often contain additional textures and mathematical models intended to model small-scale specular highlights and cavities resulting from smoothness or roughness in addition to traditional specular or reflectivity maps.
SurfacesPBR topics that deal with surfaces often rely on a simplified model of the bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF), that approximates well optical properties of the material using only handful of intuitive parameters, and that is quick to compute on a computer. Common techniques are approximations and simplified models, that try to fit approximate models to more accurate data from other more time consuming methods or laboratory measurements
*Reflection in computer graphics is used to emulate reflective objects like mirrors and shiny surfaces.*Accurate reflections can be accomplished e.g. by a ray trace renderer by following a ray from the eye to the mirror and then calculating where it bounces from, and continuing the process until no surface is found, or a non-reflective surface is found. Approximate reflections can usually be computed faster by using methods such as environment mapping. Reflection on a shiny surface like wood or tile can add to the photorealistic effects of a 3D rendering.
**Diffuse reflection**Diffuse reflection is the reflection of light or other waves or particles from a surface such that a ray incident on the surface is scattered at many angles rather than at just one angle as in the 
case of specular reflection. An ideal diffuse reflecting surface is said to exhibit Lambertian reflection, meaning that there is equal luminance when viewed from all directions lying in the half-space adjacent to the surface.
A surface built from a non-absorbing powder such as plaster, or from fibers such as paper, or from a polycrystalline material such as white marble, reflects light diffusely with great efficiency. Many common materials exhibit a mixture of specular and diffuse reflection.
The visibility of objects, excluding light-emitting ones, is primarily caused by diffuse reflection of light: it is diffusely-scattered light that forms the image of the object in the observer's eye.

description_text:
Black Hole
Simple model of a black hole similar to the one in the movie Interstellar (Gargantua) based on a tutorial by ShiveringCactus.
It is basically a black sphere and a (rotating) disk with some galaxy texture plus a refracting torus, which simulates the bending of the light behind by the strong gravity (gravity lens). I added an additional disk under the original one with a c4d galaxy shader to get some more twirly line structures around. For animation I just rotated these two disks together, which gives an impressive visual effect. description_text:
This float is designed to be used in a stingless bee sugar syrup feeder constructed from 90mm PVC pipe.The external dimeter is 85.5mm allowing for a snug fit, thereby reducing the likelihood of bees drowning whilst still being able to feed effectively.Before printing,  please consider the tollerance of your printer as well as the variance in the internal diameter of PVC pipe.The float can be used in conjuntion with a perforated lid when the total feeder height does not exceed the height of the float itself. In this instance, the stem of the float acts as a liquid feed level indicator and also as a ladder for the bees. (see photos)The current height of the float is 140mm.The gap between the stem of the float and the perforation in the lid acts as an alternate point of access to the feeder, whilst excluding larger insects. The perforated lid also works to ensure the float stays right.
I have made my feeders with additional access points in the PVC pipe (see photos attached)Please be aware that the files attached include photos of a previous prototype where the stem was more slender, however I found these were prone to breakage. The current stem diameter is 15mm and is pictured with a blue lid. My floats are printed in PLA and seems to float well with a 10% hexagonal infill.
The crawl space on this design has been tested on Australian Native Stingless Bee species, Tetragonula Hockingsi. If you intend you use this feeder with species outside Australia, you may need to consider changing the size of the crawl space.Please consider the environment when 3D printing.

description_text:
Are you making a space game or perhaps something more fantasy oriented - Well why not add some glowing stones to your scenes. Change the emission map settings to make each iteration of this model unique by changing which cracks glow and by how much. By doing this you have complete control over your scene. The possibilities are endless! Your character will have so many unique glowing stones coming at them, they won't know what to do with them all.
Model Features:
Fully textured rock surface, completely custom made using Materialize so you can be sure that when you render your rocks your results will be stunning.
The model has custom texture files ranging for Diffuse, bump, metallic, normal, smoothness, edge AO and emisson maps so when you get up close an personal the thing looks out of this world.
The emission values have been linked to the dark regions (rock's cracks) of the diffuse map so with a few tweeks of the emission values your rock can be re-used saving the need to create a whole new model to create unique and complex scenes. Re-Use and Recycle the model over and over again! 
Realistic PBR textures used with a compact model design made to be universally game friendly.
Watch as the light eradiates from the rock's cracks using several directly applied 3D effects creating a different, stunning visual effect from every angle. Use in a dark scene and watch the cracks light up or perhaps use in a well lit scene and see a dubtle glow as you marvel at the realistic rock textures. the choice is up to you.
Available Formats:
Blender (Model's Native program made with version 2.8)
Obj/Mtl (Zipped in separate files)
fbx
dae
All file formats have been separately zipped along with the textures used. 
Please check out my other models for all your creative needs. I hope to be of service to your next creative project. :)

Kuimi Beverage Can
This asset is a part of Generic Beverage Can Pack 2, check out the full pack for the complete collection!
All Kuimi Models are originally created in Blender 3D / Cycles Render.
Our Team is made by professional designers and 3D artists, and we are working hard to give the best result possible to our models in an accessible price! 
All Kuimi models are accurately scaled ready to be used in your scene (no cameras, no lighting, just the model in the center of the 3D space).
Preview Images rendered in Blender using Cycles Render (Please, note that the scene and lighting or anything that is not the model are not included).
All designs and arts in our models are made from scratch by our designers, including Logos, and general designs, there are no copyrighted brands, logos or any kind of resources. 
GEOMETRY

  - 6,080 Tris

  - 3,042 Verts

  - 3,082 Faces

  - Quad and Tris Workflow

ABOUT THE MODEL

  - PBR

  - Single Mesh Models

  - All Materials Baked in one single texture 

  - Subdivisable

  - All objects named correctly 

  - Model ready to be used! (no clean scene process needed)

  - The original model was made in Blender 3D

FILE FORMATS

  - Blend (original)

  - OBJ

  - FBX

  - DAE

  - STL

TEXTURES (4096 x 4096)

  - Color

  - Roughness

  - Metallic

  - Normal

SUBDIVISION MODEL READY
When downloaded, the model comes without subdivision levels applied. For close up renders, we highly recommend that you use subdivision levels modefiers to get best results (the preview renders were made using subdivision level 1)
PINK MODEL ERROR!!
If you are using a .Blender File, and the model was loaded pink, it means that the software could not find the correct path for the textures! please try to use “File > External Data> find missing files” to find the correct path for the textures (it should not happen, but if happens please contact us to solve the problem in the asset)
QUESTIONS
If you have any question about how to use or setup the model, report something wrong, or make some request, please contact us via support! 
Thank you!

description_text:
Gym Bench 001
All Kuimi Models are originally created in Blender 3D / Cycles Render.
Our Team is made by professional designers and 3D artists, and we are working hard to give the best result possible to our models in an accessible price! 
All Kuimi models are accurately scaled ready to be used in your scene (no cameras, no lighting, just the model in the center of the 3D space).
Preview Images rendered in Blender using Cycles Render (Please, note that the scene and lighting or anything that is not the model are not included).
All designs and arts in our models are made from scratch by our designers, including Logos, and general designs, there are no copyrighted brands, logos or any kind of resources. 
GEOMETRY

  - 111,638 Tris 

  - 56,393 Verts 

  - 56,761 Faces 

  - Quad and Tris Workflow

ABOUT THE MODEL

  - PBR

  - Single Mesh Models

  - All Materials Baked in one single texture 

  - Subdivisable

  - All objects named correctly 

  - Model ready to be used! (no clean scene process needed)

  - The original model was made in Blender 3D

FILE FORMATS

  - Blend (original)

  - OBJ

  - FBX

  - DAE

  - STL

  - ABC

  - GLB

TEXTURES (4096 x 4096 and 2048 x 2048)

  - Color

  - Roughness

  - Metallic

  - Normal

SUBDIVISION MODEL READY
When downloaded, the model comes without subdivision levels applied. For close up renders, we highly recommend that you use subdivision levels modefiers to get best. Note that in this model, only the Leather Mesh is subdivisable! (Preview renders was using Subdivision level 2). 
BEFORE PURCHASE
Please, consider downloading one of our free 3d Models, and check if everything Works Well in your software, using the native files or Universal Files (OBJ, FBX). Also check the quality of the model! 
PINK MODEL ERROR!!
If you are using a .Blender File, and the model was loaded pink, it means that the software could not find the correct path for the textures! please try to use “File > External Data> find missing files” to find the correct path for the textures (it should not happen, but if happens please contact us to solve the problem in the asset)
QUESTIONS
If you have any question about how to use or setup the model, report something wrong, or make some request, please contact us via support! 
Thank you!
KUIMI 3D MODELS

description_text:
TEXTURE PROBLEMS: If you have problems with the textures like the model is pink, the textures are wrong, you can’t apply the textures in a different software or similar, it could be due to the following things:

  - The Textures are displayed weird in Blender: Make sure you have at least version 2.82 of Blender. The model uses UDIM Textures, which are not supported in any earlier version of Blender

  - The Model is Pink: That means, that Blender could not find the Textures. Make sure that you extract the zip file first, and just move the whole folder, not the sub folder/files. Or else Blender can’t find the textures anymore.

  - Applying the Textures in After Effects Element 3D, Unity, Unreal Engine 4 and other software: The model uses UDIM Textures, which are not supported by some 3D applications. In UE4 there is a work around i think, just search for UDIM Textures in UE4 on YT. If you still want to use it in the program, you probably have to make the textures yourself.

  - The mesh is black: This could have many reasons, for example that your shader is not connected to the output node. But one common problem is that the textures are too big for the computer to display. If that happens make sure you have the 1k version, and if that still does not help, activate the simplify setting in the render settings tab. There you can choose 512 or 256 for the final render or preview render.

If these solutions could not fix it, don't hesitate to contact me.
The .blend file is in the zip archive
If you want to use this Spaceship, It would be nice if you credit me somehow. Best would be a link to my Artstation: https://www.artstation.com/dermalt
Please tag me on Twitter (@MalteUllrich2) or Instagram (@ullrichmalte), if you use it in a project. I would love to see what you come up with.
It took me about 4 months to model and texture it. I tried to model it as close as possible to the original model. Because I dont own the Star Wars IP, I'm not allowed to sell it online, even though there are a lot of people that do it anyway. Thats why I give it out for free. So if you want to support me, follow me on Social Media:
YT: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCK1SY2DaedfdE_XgYccny7Q (Malte Ullrich)
IG: @ullrichmalte
Twitter: @MalteUllrich2
Artstation: https://www.artstation.com/dermalt
This is a Production ready Mesh, all quads and tripple edged. It has about ~ 100 Udims. There is a 1k textures and a 2k textures version. I used the 1k version for the renders. The 2k version is quite heavy, so you need a good PC.
I would recommend to use the .blend file in the zip archive. This way the textures and materials are already there. I included some other file formats (fbx, obj, abc), but then you need to apply the textures yourself. I didn't plan on putting it up to download, so the names of the textures are not always perfect.
The hangar is unfortunataly not able to open/close. If you seperate it, you should though be able to animate it open.

Do you need space to store your books and other office supplies? Look no more, the ultimate solution is here! With these shelves/cabinets/storages/ whatever you want to call them, you can store even the smallest things in your office and never lose them again!
The model is optimized to be used in various situations, ranging from architectural visualization and animations to videogames. By utilizing weighted normals, realistic models are achieved with low polygon counts. Textures are utilizing Metalness PBR so they will respond realistically to the lighting of your scene. 
The model has been confirmed to work with Unreal Engine and Unity Engine and it works out of the box with all major renderers.
Following models are included:

  - Metal Shelf 100 x 100 Closed

  - Metal Shelf 100 x 100 Open Half

  - Metal Shelf 100 x 100 Open

  - Metal Shelf Window 100 x 100 Closed

  - Metal Shelf Window 100 x 100 Open Half

  - Metal Shelf Window 100 x 100 Open

The model includes the following 2k textures:

  - Albedo

  - Normal Map

  - Packed PBR (Roughness, Metalness, Ambient Occlusion)

The packaged PBR texture has the following textures assigned on RGB channels:

  - Red = Ambient Occlusion

  - Green = Roughness

  - Blue = Metalness

If you have any questions regarding the 3D models, please do not hesitate to send me a message :)

description_text:
Game ready Handheld Transceiver for PBR game engines/renderers. Modeled in 3ds Max 2021.
This product is intended for game/real time/background use. Renders done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. The Marmoset Toolbag scene is included.
||SPECS||

  - Geometry is quads and tris, no n-gons

  - All materials and objects named appropriately

  - Scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters)

  - Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (see renders)

  - Tested in Unreal Engine 4

  - No special plugins needed.

  - .obj and .fbx versions exported from 3ds Max 2021

  - Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.

|| Textures ||

  - 1024x1024 PBR base color, roughness, metalness, normal, emissive and AO (ambient occlusion)

  - Also included: textures in specular/gloss PBR format for those who prefer that setup.

  - Also included: extra texture maps such as curvature, world space normal, and world position

  - Textures designed for physically based rendering (PBR)

  - Model texture paths are stripped

I have exported specialized texture maps for Unreal Engine 4 and Unity. See the extra downloads section for those textures and instructions on using them. Substance Painter source files also available in the extra downloads so that you can easily alter the textures as you wish with Substance Painter.
